sources.summary: YouTube video 'Gajab ho gaya 😳 रेगिस्तान में अनोखा मेला Nathu DaDa 34 Ganv Lunkaransar, mahajan Rajasthan' (26:15) by Shubh Journey. Shubh Journey 1475 राजस्थान की रेगिस्तानी धरती पर स्थित एक अद्भुत मंदिर है, जो अपनी अनोखी भव्यता और संस्कृति के लिए जाना जाता है। यह मंदिर, जो रेत के धोरों के बीच स्थित है, अपने नजारे और शांति के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। शाम का समय यहां एक विशेष अनुभव होता है। जब सूर्य क्षितिज के पीछे ढलता है, तो आसमान … ट्रांसक्रिप्ट (Whisper): व्लॉगर सुलेरा से 9 किमी कच्चे रास्ते से खिंयाणा धाम पहुंचा; पुजारी ने नाथू दादा की कथा सुनाई (गौरक्षा, करणी माता के स्वप्न से रातों-रात कुआँ, 12 गांवों पर कानू का अधिकार और घोड़े की रात-भर की दौड़ से सीमा, कानू का खारबारा चले जाना, समाधि की प्रतिज्ञा); मेला साल में एक बार, रात्रि जागरण, भंडारा, टैंकर और चूने का पुराना तालाब, सुबह धोरे पर बाइक स्टंट और मतीरा।

Speech 05:30: 'we've reached Khiyana village, but Khiyana village doesn't exist today, it's all been demolished; ruins of the village can be seen somewhere; earlier there were mud houses'

Speech 06:21: 'A fair is held here only once a year'; 06:44 'water tankers are full ... there's also a pond here, filled with water from the rains'; 06:51 'food distribution at night, preparations for the jagran'
Speech 07:07: 'People from the villages around Lunkaransar ... there were 34 villages in this area, come here in large numbers'
Speech 08:33: 'it was around 80 to 90 [1980s], from where I started the video, Salera [Soolera] was a nearby village, and people from 34 villages are coming here'
Speech 04:39: '9 kilometres from here Nathu Dada temple'; village asked: 'Khiyana, Khiyana ... we are going to Khiyana Dham'

Priest 09:37-14:06 (legend): Nathu Dada protected cows; water shortage; Karni Mata appeared in his sleep and showed a well beneath him; a well dug overnight; a Muslim chief Kanu held the 12 villages under the kings' tax system; a Godara offered his daughter; the area a horse covered in one night became Nathu Dada's, the full round of the 12 villages; Kanu's mother, a saint, told him to flee and he settled at Kharbara; Nathu Dada vowed that wherever his vehicle carrying his body stopped would be his samadhi, which is here
Priest 14:16: 'this is a complete desert, only sand; there was a problem of water; Nathu Dada showed mercy and water came out in the well; after that the canal came'
Speech 15:39: 'a huge pond made of lime from Nathu Dada's time; water only in the rainy season, no tankers'

Visitors 14:55-16:48: an elderly man whose village was one of the 34 comes from Jodhpur every year with family; a young visitor names his village as Takpura [Takhtpura]; 09:09 a man says his village 'Baawala' [Berawala?] was one of the 34 and his house's mud remains are gone
Speech 21:54-22:22: morning breakfast of matira grown in surrounding fields; young men ride bikes up the dune as a challenge watched by a crowd
